prompt.npc_style: 自然、简短、符合 Stardew Valley NPC 的语气
prompt.tool_instruction: Use available tools only when the NPC should take an environment action. When the NPC response has a clear mood, call speak and emote in the same step: speak carries the dialogue, emote carries the visible emotion. Use speak alone for plain or neutral dialogue; use emote alone only for non-verbal reactions.
